lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Accrued liabilities
lines.why: Wages, services and other costs not yet paid: operating.

lines.name: Deferred revenue
lines.why: Customers' payments ahead of delivery: operating.

lines.name: Income taxes payable
lines.why: Taxes on operating income: operating.

lines.name: Current portion of long-term debt
lines.why: Borrowed money falling due within a year: financial.

lines.name: Long-term debt
lines.why: Bonds, notes and loans: financial.

lines.name: Finance lease liabilities
lines.why: Leases that work like a loan for the asset: financial.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities
lines.why: Other long-term operating obligations: operating.

lines.name: Other assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total assets minus the lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total liabilities minus the lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

Revenue from equipment sales accounted for approximately 15%, 18%, and 20% of our revenue for the fiscal years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023, respectively.

No customer accounted for more than 10 % of total revenue for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023 and no customer accounted for more than 10 % of accounts receivable as of December 31, 2025 or 2024 .

We rely on both trademark registrations and common law protection for trademarks.

We rely on third-party suppliers for equipment components and services that we use to provide our services.
Many suppliers of critical components of our equipment are single-source providers.

Components for which we rely on single-source suppliers include, among others, the antennas, routers and modems for all systems, the equipment used at our ATG cell site base stations and the HDX and FDX Terminals for our Gogo Galileo network.
We also rely on third parties to provide the links between our data centers and our ground network.

Many of our customers depend on our customer support team to assist them in deploying or using our services effectively, to help them resolve post-deployment issues quickly and to provide ongoing support.
Our ability to earn revenues from our satellite services depends on the continued operation of the satellite networks provided by our third-party vendors.
We depend on the continued service and performance of our key personnel.
